title: Semantic Asset Taxonomy, Availability Resolver & Cross-Pack Substitution

resolution_required: provider-neutral semantic asset taxonomy and requirement descriptors
permission- and provenance-aware deterministic candidate filtering and ranking
manual assignment and manual override as first-class choices
cross-pack substitution bounded by explicit compatibility and permission evidence
stable resolver receipts and explainable rejection diagnostics
selection_contract.manual_rule: Manual assignment and override remain first-class; the resolver may recommend or deterministically choose only within explicitly authorized policy and may never erase the user's or owner's deliberate selection.
selection_contract.permission_rule: Candidates with denied permissions are ineligible; unknown/unverified permission states remain unresolved rather than being treated as allowed.
selection_contract.acquisition_rule: Resolution operates only over supplied/catalogued availability evidence. It may not download, buy, authenticate to, scrape or otherwise acquire provider assets.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Resolver outputs select or describe visual assets only; MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration remain canonical owner truth.

preserved_boundaries: no vendor/editor or source format becomes canonical Multiversal map truth
no asset pack is assumed complete
semantic scene requirements remain separate from selected/available art
MAI-01 license evidence and incomplete-pack outcomes remain binding
MAI-06 raw source/import diagnostics, checksum, provenance and unsupported metadata remain preserved evidence
permissions are not inferred and unknown permission remains unresolved
manual assignment, approved-placeholder and visibly-unresolved outcomes remain first-class
cross-pack substitution cannot invent semantic compatibility or owner state
no automatic provider acquisition/download, payment or authentication
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth
MAI-07 may implement only after a future governed start and resolver-contract resolution
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read completed MAI-01..06 evidence, resolve the exact semantic taxonomy, availability, permission-aware deterministic resolver, manual override and cross-pack substitution contract, and governed-start MAI-07. Until then do not create an implementation branch or implement resolver/substitution mechanics.
